changelog:
monetization-ai 1.0.0 - Initial release

- Launches safe monetization workflows using OpenClaw, n8n, and multiple communication/integration channels.
- Supports end-to-end revenue pipelines: lead discovery, offer packaging, outreach, and conversion tracking.
- Enforces strict safety policies requiring explicit confirmation before any money movement.
- Provides recommended stack, command set, output formats, and n8n workflow handoff specifications.
- Includes guardrails to prevent spam and ensure auditability and compliance.
summary: Designs and runs safe monetization workflows (lead research, outreach drafts, content-to-offer loops, reporting) using OpenClaw + n8n + communication channel...
